description:
Take on the role of Kunya, the child of Chief Goro, leader of the Desert Snakes tribe. 

Lyara, The Beastmaster Princess about to marry Elven prince Merril. As the prince travels to meet Lyara, his caravan is assaulted by dark elves, and he is nowhere to be found in the aftermath. Now it's up to you and the party allies to investigate and find the prince. 

The Beastmaster Princess is a fantasy visual novel featuring a diverse cast, branching plot, and multiple endings. 


Features
* Epic fantasy visual novel
* Play as a male or female (both named Kunya)
* Romance 4 different characters
* Over 20 CGs
name: The Beastmaster Princess
intro: Discover the incredible secret power of The Beastmaster Princess
